versions.content: A call to J1939Nm_NetworkRequest shall set all NodeChannels of the reported channel to ‘NetworkMode’ . The J1939 Network Management module shall notif y this mode change to the NM Interface via Nm_NetworkMode, and shall trigger transmission of an AddressClaimed PG for each NodeChannel where J1939NmChannelUsesAddressArbitration is enabled .
